# The Kuailu Smart Office launched the Regenerative Resources Industry AI+ Digital Transformation Program to use data base and AI smart body decomposition of industrial pain points

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Published: 2026-04-21
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202604/21/WS69e7058ca310942cc49a895e.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202604/21/WS69e7058ca310942cc49a895e.html]

## Text
Digitalization and AI have become essential options for business survival and competition as renewable resource industry policies continue to increase. The introduction of the Kuailu AI platform has led to the establishment of a single production inventory management platform covering the mobile and Web side, which allows for real-time synchronization of multi-end data, using mission-driven “person-to-person” initiatives.

Significant results were achieved: 83.33 per cent reduction in the time taken to trace the products produced, 57.14 per cent improvement in the efficiency of cross-sectoral collaboration, 55.56 per cent improvement in multi-level inventory activity and 34.37 per cent improvement in the efficiency of production reporting. According to many head-reducing firms, the Kuailu Smart Office, the Regenerative Resources Industry AI + Digital Transformation Program, was officially launched to help enable companies to achieve compliance and business intelligence by two steps: "Data access + process solidification" and "AI penetrating + intelligence analysis"!

Industry pains: three main challenges constrain the survival of enterprises

With the release of the REAP, the industrial policy window for renewable resources has been opened. But most enterprises still rely on manual billboards, spreadsheets, and face:

- Lack of advance invoices: Failure to obtain compliance documents in transactions with bulkers, high tax risk
- Inventory management black hole: material and asset data cut off, storage product missing, cost profit not calculated
- Downstream retroactive difficulty: unable to provide full chain traceability reports, missing large plant orders.

The Kuailu Smart Office believes that the first step in the enterprise ' s transformation needs to move away from a low-quality management model with data access and process solidification, and the second step with AI data penetration and intelligence analysis to intellectualize production and decision-making. On this basis, Kuailu has officially published the AI + Digital Transition Program for the Regenerative Resources Industry.

Programme core: AI + full process control, three main advantages lead

The Kuailu Smart Office "AI+Intelligence Transformation Program for Regenerative Resources" creates a one-stop recapitalization information platform for businesses, covering the pound system, smart park system, parking system, OA and fiscal system needed by enterprises, and completes the depth of data penetration and integration.

Accomplish the digitization of more than 20 links and 6 large scenes from the “procurement warehouse production sales costs” to connect people, goods, systems to a high degree of connection, to automatically connect data, process strong controls, cost real-time accounting, inventory and retroactive accounting!

Kuailu Smart Office AI + Regenerative Resources Industry Program

Advantage one: AI Transformed “pull worker”, in/out of the plant, full process intelligence control

The program embeds AI deep into trucking, loading, unloading, categorizing, etc., using physical identification and large model decision-making analysis, intelligently predicts the amount of tons of production, and, in combination with market fluctuations, directs the firm ' s intelligent collections, scrapping, so that production plans are seamlessly aligned with sales, significantly increasing its risk resistance and market responsiveness.

Advantage two: specialty in industry, suitable for specific products such as scrap vehicles/farming machines Category

Kuailu designed "AI+BOM Table " for the subdivisions of end-of-life vehicles, agricultural machinery, batteries, etc. The system is precise in identifying vehicle types and years, automatically predicting product categories and weights, providing data support for pre-sale sales and supporting enterprise customization development.

Advantage three: batch retroactive + bar code management, full chain control

Through bar-coding and batch-number management, “the sale of finished products from batch production” is achieved

The entire process is traced, access logs are available, and regulatory compliance requirements such as environmental protection and taxation are met.

Six key scenes. All-process fine controls.

Purchase arrival: Sales create purchase orders online, the system automatically pushes to a pounder, licence plates recognize associated orders without telephone confirmation, and efficiency gains of more than 50 per cent.

Overpound and test: The mass examiner records the quality level and uploads the photos through the APP, the data is automatically synchronized, the overpound and the quality check is made to avoid confusion.

One key trace: bar code + batch number management, where a customer requests a trace report with one key to extract information such as batches of raw materials, source collection, library time, etc.

(b) One-stop management worksheets, withdrawals, reporting, warehousing, quality checks, systematic comparison of output errors, anti-feeding BOM quotas.

Accurate cost accounting: Production worksheets combined with batch management of inventory, automatic accounting of the cost of finished and semi-finished products, automatic sharing of the cost of different products in mixed scenes, and sales orders to support batch release.

Conclusion: Digitalization and AI have become essential options for business survival and competition as renewable resource industry policies continue to increase. Kuailu, the Regenerative Resource Industry AI + Digital Transformation Program, focuses on the data base and AI smart body, providing enterprises with landable, quantifiable transformation pathways to continuously supporting industrial upgrading.
